title: vernonia hymenolepis subsp. leucocalyx
intro: Vernonia hymenolepis subsp. leucocalyx, commonly known as a plant species within the daisy family, is a type of flowering plant native to certain regions. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia hymenolepis subsp. leucocalyx include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
